result.instructions: Tools for Snipcart, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the orders from the last week that are still Processed."; "Which products sold the most this month, and what did they earn?"; "Find the customer with this email and list their orders.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Snipcart data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run snipcart_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run snipcart_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run snipcart_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. snipcart_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: snipcart_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List the completed orders of the store, with optional status and payment-status filters. Returns { totalItems, offset, limit, items }. Use format=Excerpt for lighter summaries. Snipcart API: GET /orders.

status.description: Order status: InProgress, Processed, Disputed, Shipped, Delivered, Pending or Cancelled.

paymentStatus.description: Payment status: Paid, Deferred, PaidDeferred, ChargedBack, Refunded, Paidout, Failed, Pending, Expired, Cancelled, Open or Authorized.

tools.name: snipcart_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by its token, including all items, promo codes and applied taxes. Snipcart API: GET /orders/{token}.

tools.name: snipcart_list_order_refunds
tools.title: List refunds of an order
tools.description: List the refunds issued on one order, by order token. Snipcart API: GET /orders/{token}/refunds.

tools.name: snipcart_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the products of the store. Sort by sales count, sales value or creation date. Snipcart API: GET /products.

orderBy.description: NbrSales (most sold first, default), SalesValue (highest total first) or CreationDate (newest first).

userDefinedId.description: Only products whose user-defined id matches this value.

tools.name: snipcart_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product by its id. Snipcart API: GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: snipcart_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the store's customers, with optional status, exact email and name filters. Snipcart API: GET /customers.

email.description: Only the customer with this exact email.

name.description: Only customers whose billing name contains this text.

tools.name: snipcart_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. Snipcart API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: snipcart_list_customer_orders
tools.title: List orders of a customer
tools.description: List the orders placed by one customer, by customer id. Snipcart API: GET /customers/{id}/orders.

tools.name: snipcart_list_discounts
tools.title: List discount codes
tools.description: List the discount codes of the store. Snipcart API: GET /discounts.

tools.name: snipcart_get_discount
tools.title: Get a discount code
tools.description: Get one discount code by id. Snipcart API: GET /discounts/{id}.

tools.name: snipcart_list_abandoned_carts
tools.title: List abandoned carts
tools.description: List carts that were started but not paid, filtered by how long ago they were abandoned. Pass continuationToken from a previous reply to get the next page. Snipcart API: GET /carts/abandoned.

continuationToken.description: Cursor returned by a previous reply (continuationToken field).

timeRange.description: Only carts abandoned within this window.

email.description: Only carts associated with this email address.

tools.name: snipcart_get_abandoned_cart
tools.title: Get an abandoned cart
tools.description: Get one abandoned cart by its token. Snipcart API: GET /carts/abandoned/{token}.

tools.name: snipcart_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List the store's recurring subscriptions, with an optional status filter. Snipcart API: GET /dashboard/subscriptions.

status.description: Subscription status. Omitted: only non-cancelled subscriptions are returned.

customerId.description: Only subscriptions of this customer id.

tools.name: snipcart_get_subscription
tools.title: Get a subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription by id. Use version=V3 for a v3 subscription (its id is the order token). Snipcart API: GET /dashboard/subscriptions/{id}.

id.description: The subscription id (from snipcart_list_subscriptions): a GUID for V1, an order token for V3.

prompts.name: find_the_best_selling_products

prompts.description: List products sorted by sales count, sales value or creation date. Get one product by its id for its details.

prompts.name: look_up_a_customer_and_their_orders
prompts.title: Look up a customer and their orders
prompts.description: Find customers by status, exact e-mail address or name. Then list the orders that one customer placed.

prompts.name: review_abandoned_carts
prompts.title: Review abandoned carts
prompts.description: List the carts that were started but not paid, by how long ago they were abandoned. Open one cart to see what was in it.

prompts.name: check_discount_codes
prompts.title: Check discount codes
prompts.description: List the discount codes of the store, then get one code by its id.

prompts.name: review_recurring_subscriptions
prompts.title: Review recurring subscriptions
prompts.description: List the recurring subscriptions, filtered by status. Open one subscription to see its details.
